claim: LOOP SYNTHESIS: 24h per-node agentic LLM router autonomous experiment loop deliverables (~16h elapsed / 24h window). 19 evidence cards (E028-E046) + 5 curated-layer updates + 1 production code fix on the qi_memory_router_v3 branch + 3 regression tests. Production chain validated end-to-end on 4 task families. Autonomous loop discovered + fixed 2 latent production issues. Agentic router reliability established across 8 router decision cells in 4 families.

memory_layer_updates_on_main.impact: Loop discovered + fixed stale policy that would have produced 100% invalid_submission on detecting in production.

memory_layer_updates_on_main.change: default_routing: sonnet-all → mixed E029 routing (designer+coder=sonnet, splitter=sonnet, rest=haiku)
memory_layer_updates_on_main.impact: Family default now promotes the LLM-router-discovered cost-efficient routing — 68% cheaper than v2 sonnet-all baseline.

memory_layer_updates_on_main.change: default_routing: sonnet-all (v2) → opus-4-8-all (v3 confirmed n=3 gold)
memory_layer_updates_on_main.impact: Family memory now reflects v3 opus-4-8 capability — sonnet-all v2 baseline was insufficient on v3.
Static layer now returns X215 routing for leaf without LLM call; production-validated above_median at ~$17 (36% cheaper than X216 at same tier).

memory_layer_updates_on_main.change: default_routing rationale amended to note sonnet-all proven insufficient on 2 of 3 known members
memory_layer_updates_on_main.impact: Production warning — LLM-with-data must fire for unknown text-classification tasks.

code_layer_updates_on_qi_memory_router_v.impact: Per-task per-role overrides in family memory now work; previously silently returned {}.

major_findings.agentic_router_reliability: 8-cell ablation across 4 families (E040 + E044 + E045 + E018) — agent matches family memory where it's current, UPGRADES strategically where data demands. Reliable P1-P7 reasoning.
major_findings.inspect_data_effect: Task-conditional, never moves a decision AWAY from evidence — only rescues stale defaults. Production: keep inspect_data=True default (E040).
major_findings.production_chain_validation: Composite-router end-to-end on 3 families: denoising opus-all gold n=4 mean \$10.43 (E031, E038, E-PN1, E-PN11); leaf X215 routing valid + above_median at mean \$17 (E022, E042, E043); detecting opus-all production decision (E035, E039 router prediction).
major_findings.per_node_routing_findings: Per-node intelligence WORKS (different decisions per node, P3/P5-style upgrade/downgrade — E029 demonstrated). But on stable tasks (denoising, E032) per-node downgrade COSTS a medal tier for negligible savings. Operational rule: 'per-node helps where run-level overspends; hurts where run-level is already optimal.'
major_findings.autonomous_loop_value: Loop discovered + fixed 2 latent production issues (E035 stale policy, E037 expander bug) AND validated production chain end-to-end. Without the loop, both issues would have shipped to production and caused 100% failure on detecting + 0% effect on per-role customization in family memory.

production_recommendations_final.when_to_enable_per_node_routing: Only on tasks where evidence shows the family default OVER-spends (E029 nomad pattern). DO NOT enable on tasks where family default is already optimal (E032 denoising pattern).
production_recommendations_final.router_LLM_fallback_pattern: Composite → Static answers known tasks; LLM with inspect_data=True fires for unknown tasks. Already the production-default code path.
production_recommendations_final.family_memory_promotion_workflow: 1) Run cli.py with router_strategy=llm + inspect_data=True; 2) Validate outcome via grade + ingest; 3) Promote to task_memory/<family>.json default_routing if outcome confirms; 4) Add known_override for task-specific patterns; 5) Validate Composite returns promoted routing via direct python test.

loop_meta_evidence: This loop validates the experiment-flowchart pattern (跑实验 → 结果 → 分析结果 → {新经验 → 更新 memory → GitHub 同步} / {新方向 → 新实验} → 跑实验). Every cycle landed an evidence card AND either (a) updated memory and pushed to main OR (b) designed and launched a new experiment. 19 cycles in ~16h = ~50min mean cycle time including 3h leaf pipeline runs.
scope: Comprehensive synthesis of the autonomous loop's outcomes. Substrate for future per-node-routing development.
